dict.string: We use your location to display GPS coordinates, altitude, speed, and compass heading.
We use motion sensors to display accelerometer, gyroscope, pedometer, and activity data.
We use the camera to show camera capabilities and control the torch/flashlight.
We use the microphone to show audio input device information.
We use Bluetooth to scan for nearby devices and display Bluetooth status.
We read health data such as steps, heart rate, and activity to display in the Health tab.
We can write workout and activity data to HealthKit.
